title: Miri Changelog
description: Machine-readable release history shipped in a wheel's agent-metadata/ as changelog.json. Mirrors the CLI family's proven `changelog --since` payload (MIRI-CLI-029) so the two targets share one shape. It exists because the wheel metadata set recorded breaking changes (migration-guide.json) and had no home for 'what was fixed', so a fix shipped with a silent changelog never reached a downstream's tooling - the incident that produced this schema. Every symbol named here is a claim that a linter JOINS against api_index in the current or previous release; an entry naming a symbol that resolves in neither is a dangling claim. The document is CONDITIONAL on a previous release existing (the MIRI-PY-030/034 pattern): a first release MAY ship it with its initial entry, and whenever it ships, releases[0].version MUST equal the wheel's version or the check fires (version silence).

schema_version.description: Top-level, per the MIRI-CLI-010 convention. Bumped only when this document's shape changes.

generated_at.description: Build-window stamp, as for every other agent-metadata document (MIRI-PY-011 applies).

releases.description: Newest first. releases[0] describes the release this wheel IS - the version-silence join. Ordering MUST be monotonic descending by PEP 440 version.

version.description: PEP 440 version string of the release described.

deprecated.description: Deprecations announced in this release. The authoritative record is migration-guide.json; an entry here MUST agree with it (deprecation coherence).

removed.description: Surfaces removed in this release. Every removal in the measured API delta MUST appear here (uncovered delta), and MUST also be listed in migration-guide.json (MIRI-PY-030).

symbols.description: Dotted public names this entry concerns. Each MUST resolve in api_index of the current release, or - for `removed` and `deprecated` - of the previous release. Optional on `fixed` entries that name no surface.

refs.description: Issue or PR references, e.g. '#412'. Never an input to any score.
